data.one_liner: Animated introduction screen widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple, animated onboarding flow with customizable slides, images, titles, and descriptions. It includes page indicators and a callback for completion.
use_when: You need a quick onboarding flow with minimal code
You want animated transitions between intro screens
You prefer a declarative widget over custom page views
avoid_when: You need complex navigation logic beyond a simple intro
You require deep link handling or multi-step onboarding with user input
weaknesses: No support for dynamic content loading
No built-in navigation to other screens
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: smooth_page_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides more indicator styles and customization

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers richer animation options for intro screens
